name: Empty state
summary: What a list shows when there is nothing in it: a small drawing in the system's own colours, what it means, when that changes, and one thing to do.
use: when a list or page has nothing in it yet
a11y: The drawing is decorative and hidden from screen readers; the heading says what the state means, and the one primary action is a real button.

use_when: a list someone has cleared, where the message should say all is done and when new items will arrive
avoid_when: something went wrong loading the list: use alert-banners with a retry action
a first-run checklist of several steps to get going: use setup-steps
a short notice above a list that still has items: use alert-banners

parts.name: art
parts.what: a small icon drawing in a sunken tile, with a status badge in its corner

parts.name: body
parts.what: one sentence on when that changes

empty.how: this component is the empty state of a list or page

loading.how: do not show it while the list is still loading; show the list's own placeholder rows until it is known to be empty

error.how: for a failed load, use alert-banners instead, or swap the badge for a warning icon and make the button Try again

disabled.how: while the action runs, set disabled on the button and add a :disabled style in the disabled colours

overflow.how: the actions wrap, and in a narrow box they stack and take the full width

long_text.how: the heading balances its lines and the sentence wraps at 38 characters

keyboard: Tab reaches the main button, then the link
Enter or Space presses the button; Enter follows the link
